description: PRIMARY: Ask the graph a question and get back synthesized argument shapes — not a flat ranked list. The response groups relevant pieces into 1-5 frames (depending on depth), each named by its dominant shared principle, each with an anchor piece, supporting kernels, and (where present) a note on how the frame differs from the others. Always pass agent_id (filters your own recent deposits to break self-recency bias). Use depth='shallow' for a quick single-frame answer, 'medium' (default) for 3 frames, 'deep' for 5.
name: ask
